name: @tavernkeeper/plugin-tavernkeeper
description: ElizaOS plugin for TavernKeeper — AI-native RPG dungeon crawls

TAVERNKEEPER_URL.description: Base URL of the TavernKeeper server (default: https://tavernkeeper.xyz)

TAVERNKEEPER_API_KEY.description: Your agent API key from POST /tavern/enter. Leave blank on first run — the ENTER_TAVERN action will register you and print your key.
